id: -371-斯巴達對維奧蒂亞聯盟的第一次起義
theater: 留克特拉、曼提涅亞與拉科尼亞

battle.name: 斯巴達對維奧蒂亞聯盟的第一次起義
battle.theater: 留克特拉、曼提涅亞與拉科尼亞
battle.brief: 公元前371年，底比斯主導的維奧蒂亞聯盟拒絕斯巴達解散聯盟的最後通牒，在留克特拉平原會戰。7月6日交鋒，埃帕米農達斯以五十列縱深的左翼重步兵配騎兵，擊破斯巴達右翼迂迏隊並打崩其左翼。卡面的科林斯青銅盔象徵重裝步兵的世代裝備：正面開眼、視野狹窄，戴盔者只能靠隊形活。

kit.name: 科林斯青銅盔
kit.history: 全正面開眼的青銅盔。看得見的代價是：戴它的人只能靠隊形活。

countries: 這場起義發生在公元前371年，交戰的兩邊都不是國家，而是聯盟對聯盟。斯巴達一方是拉科尼亞的斯巴達城邦為首的伯羅奔尼撒聯盟：國家權力由兩支王族分掌，國王之下設五名監察官與長老會議，公民按共膳班編為伍，成年男子受國家教養制度訓練，戰時抽編為重裝步兵，徵召範圍狹而裝備齊。斯巴達在聯盟中長期扮演霸主，公元前387年科林斯戰爭之後，它的霸權靠波斯王阿爾塔薛西斯二世認可的王和平維持，被後人稱作斯巴達人的和平。維奧蒂亞一方是底比斯主導的維奧蒂亞聯盟：聯盟由十一人議事會主持，設四名輪任的聯盟執政官，主要城邦各出重裝步兵與騎兵編入聯盟軍，底比斯城邦本身另有三百人的聖隊與一批在軍事學校受訓的年輕軍官。聯盟靠底比斯的城防與波俄提亞山區的礦產維持向心力，聯盟執政官的輪任制度則專門用來限制任何一城獨霸。開戰時斯巴達拉上雅典：雅典害怕底比斯壟斷維奧蒂亞，於公元前371年短暫與斯巴達結盟，雅典重裝步兵統帥卡布里阿斯在陣中。底比斯一方有阿爾戈斯、曼提涅亞與塞薩利作盟友，遠方還有波斯的津貼撐腰。性質上，這是一場以聯盟名義行之、以各城邦軍力為骨幹的希臘內戰，勝敗取決於哪些城肯把自己的重裝步兵交出來，以及騎兵與地形的配合，而不是由某一城獨力承擔。
countriesEn: This revolt broke out in 371 BC, and neither side was a state: it was one alliance against another. On the Spartan side stood the Peloponnesian League led by the city-state of Sparta in Laconia. Power was shared between two royal houses, with five ephors and a council of elders below the kings; citizens were organised into messes, the men of military age trained under the Spartan system of upbringing, and mustered as hoplites when war came, so that the levy was narrow but the equipment uniform. Sparta had long acted as hegemon of the League, and after the Corinthian War of 395-387 BC its position rested on the King's Peace guaranteed by the Persian king Artaxerxes II, a settlement afterwards remembered as the peace of the Spartans. On the other side stood the Boeotian League led by Thebes. The League was governed by a council of eleven, with four Boeotarchs rotating among the constituent cities; the main cities each furnished hoplites and cavalry to the federal army, while Thebes city itself maintained its own three hundred-man Sacred Band and a body of young officers trained in its military school. Cohesion rested on the fortifications of Thebes and on the metal of the Boeotian hills, and the rotation of the Boeotarchs existed precisely to prevent any single city from dominating. Athens was drawn onto the Spartan side when the war opened, frightened that Boeotia might grow too strong, and the Athenian hoplite commander Chabrias served in the Spartan ranks. The Theban side had allies in Argos, Mantinea and Thessaly, with Persian money arriving from afar to back it. In character this was a Greek civil war fought in the name of alliances and built on the man-power of the city-states: what decided it was which cities would hand over their hoplites, and how cavalry and ground were combined, rather than the effort of any single polis.
people: 留下姓名的關鍵人物集中在底比斯一邊。埃帕米農達斯約生於公元前418年，是波呂姆尼斯的兒子，據說生來一足跛行，父親便給他一根手杖而不是長矛；他早年受佩洛皮達斯影響，公元前379年奪取卡德美亞城門之役後兩度被放逐，卻在流亡中創建了自己的軍事學派。留克特拉的戰術出自他的設計：他不接受斯巴達以右翼精兵迂迏的傳統做法，寧可把右翼停在原地不進。佩洛皮達斯是底比斯的另一位統帥，也是人稱底比斯解放者的人；他率領的聖隊是這支部隊最硬的核心，公元前364年他在色雷斯海岸對色薩利人的海戰中陣亡。底比斯騎兵由佩洛尼達斯率領，他在留克特拉擊潰斯巴達的左翼騎兵，這一擊直接決定了戰局。斯巴達方面的前線指揮是國王克里奧姆布羅圖斯，歐列斯勞斯二世之子，戰死留克特拉；其父歐列斯勞斯二世是斯巴達霸權最後一位主導者，留克特拉之日他並不在前線，而是在斯巴達主持外交，並於公元前360年遠征埃及。導火線的製造者是斯巴達的監察官萊庫古，他代表斯巴達向各城發出解散聯盟的最後通牒；他與傳說中的斯巴達立法者同名，但兩人不可混為一談。雅典方面出面的是卡布里阿斯，他早年在對波斯人的戰鬥中下令在盔上加裝馬頭飾，讓遠處的對手誤認是騎兵，開戰時他站在斯巴達一邊；雅典另一名將領伊菲克拉底以傭兵指揮官的身分在同時期的希臘戰場活動，他改裝重裝步兵的嘗試在當時引起很大議論。留下記錄的是色諾芬，他的《希臘史》第五卷記下留克特拉與其後的拉科尼亞戰事；狄奧多羅斯《歷史文庫》第十五卷保存了最詳細的編制與傷亡數字；普魯塔克《佩洛皮達斯傳》記下聖隊與埃帕米農達斯戰術的細節；尼波《卡布里阿斯傳》則留下雅典人在此役中的角色。
peopleEn: Those whose names survive are concentrated on the Theban side. Epaminondas was born about 418 BC as the son of Polymnis; he is said to have been lame in one leg from birth, so that his father gave him a staff instead of a spear. He came under the influence of Pelopidas early, was twice exiled after the seizure of the Cadmea in 379 BC, and built his own school of military thought during those years of exile. The tactics of Leuctra were his design: he refused the Spartan habit of sending the elite right wing round the enemy, and preferred to hold his own right wing still. Pelopidas was Thebes' other general, the man called the liberator of Thebes, and the Sacred Band under his command was the hardest core of the army; he was killed in 364 BC in a sea fight against the Thessalians off the Thracian coast. The Theban cavalry was led by Pelonidas, who broke the Spartan left wing at Leuctra, and that blow decided the battle. The field command on the Spartan side lay with the king Cleombrotus, son of Agesilaus II, who fell at Leuctra; his father, Agesilaus II, the last great director of the Spartan hegemony, was not on the battlefield that day but held diplomacy in Sparta, and in 360 BC he went on the expedition to Egypt. The match was lit by the Spartan ephor Lycurgus, who carried the Spartan demand for the dissolution of the League to the cities; he shares his name with the legendary Spartan lawgiver, and the two must not be confused. On the Athenian side came Chabrias, who had earlier ordered horse-head crests fixed to his men's helmets so that the enemy would mistake them for cavalry, and who now fought on the Spartan side; another Athenian, Iphicrates, was active in Greek battles of the same period as a commander of mercenary troops, and his attempts to re-equip the hoplite caused a great deal of talk. The record was kept by Xenophon, whose Hellenica, book five, gives Leuctra and the campaigns in Laconia that followed; Diodorus Siculus, in the fifteenth book of his Library of History, preserves the fullest account of the orders of battle and the casualty figures; Plutarch, in his Life of Pelopidas, records the Sacred Band and the detail of Epaminondas' tactics; and Cornelius Nepos, in his Life of Chabrias, preserves the part played by the Athenians in this war.
kits: 卡面這頂科林斯青銅盔是希臘重裝步兵世代的裝備，但老老實實講清楚：到了公元前371年，標準的希臘重裝步兵早已改戴開面式的阿提卡式青銅盔，遮住眼鼻的科林斯式全封閉面甲在前五世紀就退出主流，只在保守隊伍與世家收藏中留蹤。它約重一公斤上下，眼睛與鼻孔只留一條狹縫，視野被自己鑄的青銅框死；戴上之後聽得見腳步，看不見斜刺而來的矛尖。留克特拉戰場上它仍有位置：底比斯聖隊以銅製盾牌與加長的矛著名，狄奧多羅斯如此記載，普魯塔克則寫這支部隊永遠整裝待戰，金屬來自維奧蒂亞的山區；雅典統帥卡布里阿斯更早前在對斯巴達的戰鬥中下令在盔上加馬頭飾，讓遠處的底比斯人誤認是騎兵，尼波《卡布里阿斯傳》記下了這一招。會戰的勝負與盔無關，取決於另一批裝備：一邊是斯巴達式的大圓盾、重標槍、短劍與脛甲，配傳統的精銳右翼；另一邊是底比斯的加長矛，左翼列裝可達兩公尺以上的長矛，配更厚的圓盾與亞麻或銅製胸甲，用以在盾牆後接住斯巴達的衝鋒。兩軍都不用攻城器械，只用步槍、矛、弓、投石索與標槍，輔助兵種提供投射火力。斯巴達真正的短板是馬：全軍騎兵總數只有三百人，遠不足以追擊潰退的步兵；底比斯聯軍的騎兵卻有數千，能在半天之內改寫會戰。攻城器械也不是底比斯的短板，遠征拉科尼亞時底比斯軍用過撞槌與龜甲盾牆，這一點在後來的伯羅奔尼撒戰線上才真正顯現。
kitsEn: The Corinthian bronze helmet on the card belongs to an earlier generation of Greek hoplite equipment, and the honest position has to be stated plainly: by 371 BC the standard Greek hoplite had long since taken to the open-faced Attic bronze helmet, and the fully closed Corinthian type, with the eyes and nose shut in behind a bronze frame, had left the mainstream in the fifth century BC, surviving only in conservative units and in the collections of old families. It weighs about a kilogram, give or take according to date and pattern, and the eye and nose holes are reduced to a narrow slit: once it is on, the wearer can hear the footsteps but cannot see a spear coming in from the side. Even so, the type still had a place at Leuctra. The Theban Sacred Band was famous for its bronze shields and its lengthened spears, as Diodorus records, while Plutarch writes that the band was always kept in readiness for battle; the metal came out of the hills of Boeotia; Chabrias, the Athenian commander, had earlier ordered horse-head crests fixed to his men's helmets so that the Thebans at a distance would take them for cavalry, and Nepos preserves that trick in his Life of Chabrias. The outcome of the battle, however, had nothing to do with helmets; it turned on another set of equipment. On one side, the Spartan great round shield, the heavy thrusting spear, the short sword and the greaves, paired with the traditional elite right wing. On the other, the Theban lengthened spears, the left wing armed with pikes of more than two metres, matched with thicker round shields and corselets of linen or bronze plate, so that the shield wall could catch the Spartan charge. Neither army brought siege engines, only pikes, spears, bows, slings and javelins, with auxiliaries supplying missile fire. The real Spartan shortage was horses: the whole army fielded only three hundred riders, far too few to pursue infantry that broke, whereas the Theban league fielded several thousand, enough to rewrite the engagement within half a day. Siege engines were not a Theban weakness either; in the campaign into Laconia the Theban army used rams and the tortoise, and that capability only showed itself later on the Peloponnesian front.
tactics: 留克特拉之戰的戰術可以拆成三層。第一層是行軍與戰場選擇：底比斯軍自城出發往西南，越過通往基泰戎山的道路，抵達留克特拉平原時正是盛夏；古史家記載底比斯人連日行軍、臨陣缺水仍不退。斯巴達人佔據坡地較高的一側，底比斯左翼位於低處的谷地，本來是吃虧的地形。第二層是隊形：埃帕米農達斯把全軍最精銳的聖隊與重步兵集中在左翼，縱深拉到五十列，兵與兵之間密集疊在一起，使前排的盾不僅遮住自己，也遮住身後五十列的矛尖；右翼反其道而行，埃帕米農達斯下令右翼停在原地不進，把整條戰線變成一段向斯巴達凸出的弧線，任由斯巴達左翼拉開、與中央脫節。第三層是騎兵與包抄：斯巴達照例以右翼精銳迂迏，左翼被底比斯騎兵擊中後向山麓退走，底比斯騎兵緊追不放，隨即轉向斯巴達右翼迂迏部隊的側後，斯巴達縱隊被拉成三段，中央被深陣壓垮，右翼迂迏部隊失去支撐而崩潰。必須說明：拒絕右翼進攻這一招本身並非萬能，埃帕米農達斯在前一年的波俄提亞戰役中用過類似安排而失利，真正決定留克特拉的是縱深與騎兵的組合，而斯巴達的敗因是慣用的右翼迂迏撞上對方拒絕右翼的陷阱，加上左翼被騎兵打崩，兩翼同時失去作用。會戰之後底比斯立刻轉入戰略進攻：公元前370年全軍深入拉科尼亞，攻入斯巴達城郊，迫使依附斯巴達的城邦倒戈，並在一次野外交鋒中俘獲三百名斯巴達重裝步兵，斯巴達城內同時出現大規模釋放希洛人的記載。收官在公元前362年曼提涅亞平原：斯巴達在埃帕米農達斯陣亡後重新站穩，聯盟瓦解，通用和平落地。
tacticsEn: The tactics of Leuctra can be taken apart in three layers. The first is the march and the choice of ground: the Theban army marched out of the city to the south-west, crossed the road towards Mount Cithaeron, and reached the plain of Leuctra in the height of summer; the ancient historians record that the Thebans, worn by days of marching and parched with thirst, did not fall back. The Spartans held the higher ground on the slope, the Theban left wing was down in the hollow, and on the face of it the Thebans had the worse of the ground. The second layer is the formation: Epaminondas massed the finest of the Theban army, the Sacred Band and the heavy infantry, on the left, drawn up fifty ranks deep, files packed so close that the shields of the front rank covered not only their own men but the points of the spears of the fifty ranks behind; the right wing did the opposite, for Epaminondas ordered it to stand still and not advance, turning the whole line into an arc bulging towards the Spartans and letting the Spartan left pull away from the centre. The third layer is the cavalry and the envelopment. The Spartans did as they always did and sent the elite of the right wing round the enemy; their left was hit by the Theban cavalry and fell back towards the hills, the Theban horse pursued it without giving it room and then swung into the flank and rear of the Spartan flanking column, the Spartan line was torn into three, the centre was crushed by the deep formation, and the flanking column lost its support and dissolved. It must be said that the refused flank was not in itself a universal trick: Epaminondas had used a similar arrangement in the Boeotian war of the previous year and had been beaten. What really decided Leuctra was the combination of depth and cavalry, and the Spartan defeat came from the trap of a refused flank meeting their habit of sending the right wing round, together with a left wing broken by horse, so that both wings failed at once. After the engagement the Thebans turned at once to the strategic offensive: in 370 BC the whole army marched deep into Laconia, entered the approaches of the Spartan city, forced dependent cities of the Peloponnese to break away, and in one clash in the open country captured three hundred Spartan hoplites; at the same time the first large-scale manumission of helots is recorded inside the Spartan city. The war ended on the plain of Mantinea in 362 BC: Sparta re-established itself after the death of Epaminondas, the league fell apart, and the common peace was laid down.
data: 可以核的數字大致如下。時間：會戰通行紀年為公元前371年7月6日，部分記載作7月7日；戰爭自公元前371年開打，延續到公元前362年曼提涅亞之戰後的通用和平，前後約九年。兵員：狄奧多羅斯記底比斯聯軍步兵約七千人、騎兵約三千人，其中底比斯城邦本部步兵六千人、騎兵五百人，其餘由阿爾戈斯、曼提涅亞與塞薩利盟友湊出；斯巴達方面步兵約六千人、騎兵三百人，斯巴達公民兵只佔其中一部分，盟邦兵員居大多數。陣形：底比斯左翼縱深五十列，這是古代文獻中最常被引用的數字。傷亡：斯巴達方面陣亡約三百人，其中含國王克里奧姆布羅圖斯；底比斯聯軍陣亡約七百人，有記載作一千人，盟邦死者另計。俘虜：公元前370年拉科尼亞戰線的一次交鋒中，三百名斯巴達重裝步兵被俘。地理：會戰地點在底比斯西南的維奧蒂亞平原，緊靠阿索普斯河與基泰戎山麓，斯巴達人佔坡地較高的一側，底比斯左翼在低處谷地，縱深得以逐步展開。裝備重量：科林斯式全封閉青銅盔約一公斤上下，不同年代與形制有出入；底比斯左翼的加長矛長兩公尺以上。編制：維奧蒂亞聯盟議事會十一人、聯盟執政官四名，主要城邦各出一支五百至一千人的重裝步兵與相應騎兵。曼提涅亞一役的兵員各方記載分歧很大，斯巴達聯軍被說成一萬一千人，底比斯聯軍六千至八千人，實際到場數字無從確定。史料是色諾芬《希臘史》第五卷、狄奧多羅斯《歷史文庫》第十五卷、普魯塔克《佩洛皮達斯傳》與尼波《卡布里阿斯傳》，彼此互有出入，數字宜以概數為度。
dataEn: The checkable figures run roughly as follows. Date: the battle is conventionally dated to 6 July 371 BC, with some accounts giving 7 July; the war was opened in 371 BC and ran to the common peace that followed the battle of Mantinea in 362 BC, some nine years in all. Numbers on the field: Diodorus gives the Theban league about seven thousand foot and three thousand horse, of which the city of Thebes itself supplied six thousand foot and five hundred horse, the remainder being made up by allies from Argos, Mantinea and Thessaly; on the Spartan side about six thousand foot and three hundred horse, the Spartan citizens forming only a part of the foot and the allies most of the rest. Formation: fifty ranks deep on the Theban left, the most frequently quoted number in the ancient texts. Losses: about three hundred of the Spartan side fell, among them the king Cleombrotus; on the Theban league side about seven hundred fell, with one account giving a thousand, and the allied contingents apart. Prisoners: in one clash on the Laconian front in 370 BC, three hundred Spartan hoplites were taken. Geography: the battlefield lay on the Boeotian plain to the south-west of Thebes, hard by the Asopus river and the foot of Mount Cithaeron; the Spartans held the higher slope and the Theban left stood in the hollow below, where the depth of the formation could be drawn out step by step. Weights and sizes: the fully closed Corinthian bronze helmet runs to about a kilogram, varying with date and pattern; the lengthened pikes of the Theban left exceeded two metres. Establishments: a Boeotian council of eleven and four Boeotarchs, with the main cities each furnishing a body of five hundred to a thousand hoplites and a corresponding amount of cavalry. The figures for Mantinea differ widely between authorities, the Spartan league being put at eleven thousand and the Theban league at six to eight thousand, and the numbers actually present cannot be established. The sources are Xenophon's Hellenica, book five, Diodorus Siculus' Library of History, book fifteen, Plutarch's Life of Pelopidas and Cornelius Nepos' Life of Chabrias; they disagree with one another, so the figures are best given as approximations.
cause: 要理解起義為何爆發，得從前一年的國際安排說起。公元前387年科林斯戰爭結束時，波斯王阿爾塔薛西斯二世推動的王和平給予希臘各城自治，名義上終結了斯巴達的霸權；公元前375年重訂時條文加了一句含糊的附加語，凡自認為獨立的城市均可自治，這句話讓底比斯得以保留維奧蒂亞聯盟，也讓其他城邦學會用它來抵擋斯巴達。公元前371年斯巴達要求各城真正獨立，監察官萊庫古把最後通牒送到底比斯：解散聯盟，拆掉除底比斯以外各城的城牆。底比斯拒絕，因為聯盟的存在正是底比斯國力的來源，也是它抵擋斯巴達的唯一屏障，拆聯盟等於拆掉自己的國防。於是聯盟各城準備應戰，埃帕米農達斯接掌聯盟軍。外部條件同時改變：斯巴達的盟友在波斯與埃及方向分心，遠征能力受限；底比斯得到波斯津貼與阿爾戈斯、曼提涅亞的支持；雅典害怕維奧蒂亞的勢力坐大，反而在開戰初期站到斯巴達一邊。深層原因是結構性的：斯巴達的霸權靠聯盟城邦提供兵源與稅收維持，一旦有聯盟變成有實力、有領袖、有錢的對等聯盟，霸權的基礎就動搖。底比斯城內還有另一層背景：公元前379年奪取卡德美亞城門的革命把一批流亡者與被放逐的將領送回來，埃帕米農達斯正是在這種氣氛裡成形的。前378至前377年的波俄提亞戰役中聯盟曾擊敗斯巴達，這次正面起義則是把那次成功推到極點的最後一搏。
causeEn: To understand why the revolt broke out one has to begin with the international settlement of the previous year. When the Corinthian War ended in 387 BC, the King's Peace promoted by the Persian king Artaxerxes II granted autonomy to the Greek cities and formally ended the Spartan hegemony; when it was renewed in 375 BC, a vague rider was added, providing that all who judged themselves independent should be independent, and that clause allowed Thebes to keep the Boeotian League while teaching the other cities how to use it against Sparta. In 371 BC Sparta demanded real independence for every city, and the ephor Lycurgus carried the final ultimatum to Thebes: dissolve the League, and pull down the walls of every Boeotian city except Thebes. Thebes refused, because the League was the source of Theban strength and the only screen it had against Sparta; to dissolve it would have been to dismantle its own defence. The cities of the League therefore prepared for war and Epaminondas took command of the federal army. The conditions outside had changed at the same time: Sparta's allies were absorbed by Persian and Egyptian affairs and its capacity for distant campaigns was limited; Thebes had Persian subsidies and the backing of Argos and Mantinea; and Athens, afraid that Boeotia would grow too powerful, stood with Sparta in the opening weeks. The deeper cause was structural. Spartan hegemony rested on the man-power and the taxes of the allied cities, and the moment one league became a league with real strength, a leader and money of its own, the basis of the hegemony was shaken. There was a second layer inside Thebes: the revolution that seized the Cadmea in 379 BC brought back exiles and exiled officers, and Epaminondas was formed in that atmosphere. In the Boeotian war of 378-377 BC the League had already beaten Sparta, and this open revolt was the last push that carried that success to its extreme.
impact: 留克特拉的直接結果是斯巴達霸權的終結。公元前370年底比斯聯軍開入拉科尼亞，斯巴達城被攻破，斯巴達人被逐，拉科尼亞出現大規模釋放希洛人的記載，恢復自由身的希洛人被編入底比斯與阿爾戈斯的軍隊；斯巴達的盟邦如厄利斯與麥加羅波利斯相繼脫離，伯羅奔尼撒聯盟實際瓦解。對底比斯自己，這是一場代價慘重的勝利：前368年曼提涅亞一役重創斯巴達聯軍，但聯盟的內部裂痕同時加深；前362年再戰曼提涅亞，埃帕米農達斯在前線扭轉戰局時被長矛刺中胸口身亡，斯巴達的將領卻沒有陣亡，聯盟軍在失去核心人物的情況下退回底比斯，維奧蒂亞聯盟隨即瓦解，底比斯的霸權只維持了不到十年。希臘世界此後進入通用和平的年代，公元前361年起各城邦在波斯的仲裁下簽署總和約，名義上獲得自治，實際上是馬其頓介入前的自由真空。更深遠的影響在戰術與制度：埃帕米農達斯的深陣、拒絕右翼與集中騎兵的辦法，被後世視為希臘戰術的一次革命；他一手帶出來的門生一批人，包括其後被扣留在底比斯作人質的馬其頓王子腓力，都把這套打法帶走，日後腓力二世改革馬其頓方陣時，底比斯的戰術經驗是常被引用的來源之一。這場起義也確立了希臘城邦間的一條政治規則：只要有城邦足夠富裕、有鐵礦、養得起馬，又能輸出一個壓得住全聯盟的統帥，斯巴達式的單極霸權就不再穩固。這個判斷在往後半個世紀裡被反覆驗證，直到羅馬的戰爭取代了城邦之間的戰爭。
impactEn: The direct consequence of Leuctra was the end of the Spartan hegemony. In 370 BC the Theban league marched into Laconia, the Spartan city was taken, the Spartans were driven out, and a large-scale manumission of helots is recorded in Laconia, the freed helots being enrolled in the armies of Thebes and Argos; allied cities of the Peloponnese such as Elis and Megalopolis broke away in turn, and the Peloponnesian League collapsed in fact if not in name. For Thebes itself it was a victory bought at a heavy price. The battle of Mantinea in 368 BC mauled the Spartan league, but the cracks inside the League widened at the same time; at Mantinea in 362 BC, when Epaminondas was struck in the chest by a spear while trying to turn the battle in the front rank, no Spartan commander fell, the league army withdrew to Thebes without its central figure, the Boeotian League fell apart, and Theban hegemony lasted barely another decade. The Greek world then entered the age of the common peace: from 361 BC the cities signed a general settlement under the arbitration of Persia, autonomy in name and, in reality, a vacuum that preceded the intervention of Macedon. The deeper effect lies in tactics and institutions. Epaminondas' deep formation, his refused flank and his concentration of the cavalry came to be regarded as a revolution in Greek warfare; the school of officers he trained carried the method away with them, among them the Macedonian prince Philip, who was held in Thebes as a hostage, and the Theban experience is a standard source cited whenever Philip II reorganised the Macedonian phalanx. The revolt also established a political rule for the Greek city-states: as long as some city was rich enough, had iron, could keep horses and could produce a commander able to overawe the whole league, the one-pole Spartan hegemony was no longer secure. That judgement was tested again and again over the following half century, until the wars of Rome displaced the wars of the city-states.
result: 就戰役本身而言，公元前371年7月的留克特拉以底比斯的慘勝告終：斯巴達方面陣亡約三百人，國王克里奧姆布羅圖斯當場陣亡，底比斯聯軍陣亡約七百人；斯巴達隨即求和，接受維奧蒂亞聯盟繼續存在的事實，這是希臘城邦史上第一次有城邦聯盟迫使斯巴達接受自治聯盟的條款。戰爭的走向卻沒有停在留克特拉：公元前370年埃帕米農達斯率軍深入拉科尼亞，斯巴達城幾乎不設防而被占領，斯巴達的霸權體系當場崩解；其後數年在伯羅奔尼撒、拉科尼亞、塞薩利與阿卡迪亞各線反覆拉鋸，前368年的曼提涅亞戰役底比斯大勝斯巴達聯軍，前362年曼提涅亞再戰則成了這場起義的終點，埃帕米農達斯陣亡，維奧蒂亞聯盟解體，底比斯退回維奧蒂亞，此後十年沒有再能主導希臘。對斯巴達而言，這是一場代價慘重的存亡之戰：公民兵折損近三百人正好說明斯巴達人口基數之薄，兵源與馬匹的短缺從此再無解決之道，國王的權力也從此被監察官與盟邦架空。通用和平之後，希臘進入城邦結盟重組期，公元前357年第三次神聖戰爭又把底比斯拖入戰爭，這次它邀來馬其頓的援軍，結果是把希臘的主導權交到腓力二世手上。可以這樣總結：第一次起義在軍事上徹底成功，在政治上把斯巴達打得遍體鱗傷，卻把下一個霸權的位置留給了馬其頓；留克特拉真正決定的是誰來繼承希臘的霸權，而不是希臘人是否自由。
resultEn: As a battle, the outcome of Leuctra in July 371 BC was a costly victory for Thebes: about three hundred of the Spartan side fell, among them the king Cleombrotus who was killed on the field, and about seven hundred of the Theban league fell; Sparta then sued for peace and accepted the continued existence of the Boeotian League, the first time in the history of the Greek city-states that a league of cities had forced a clause of this kind on Sparta. The war itself did not stop at Leuctra. In 370 BC Epaminondas marched deep into Laconia, the Spartan city, almost undefended, was occupied, and the whole structure of the hegemony collapsed on the spot; for several years afterwards the fighting ran along the Peloponnese, Laconia, Thessaly and Arcadia in turn, with Thebes winning the battle of Mantinea in 368 BC against the Spartan league, and it was the second battle of Mantinea in 362 BC that closed the revolt: Epaminondas was killed, the Boeotian League broke up, Thebes withdrew into Boeotia and for ten years more played no leading part in Greece. For Sparta this was a war for survival at a heavy price. The loss of close to three hundred citizen hoplites showed exactly how thin the Spartan base of population was; the shortage of men and horses was never solved again, and the authority of the kings was from then on hollowed out by the ephors and by the allies. After the common peace, Greece entered a period of the re-alliance of the city-states, and the Third Sacred War of 357 BC dragged Thebes into the fighting once more, this time calling in Macedonian aid, with the result that the leadership of Greece passed to Philip II. The first revolt, in short, was an outright military success that left Sparta politically mauled, yet it handed the place of the next hegemon to Macedon. What Leuctra really decided was who would inherit the hegemony of Greece, not whether the Greeks would be free.
